title: hasFrozenIntegerComparand excuses EVERY integer comparand in a command as soon …
description:
hasFrozenIntegerComparand excuses EVERY integer comparand in a command as soon as ANY live-derivation token appears anywhere in that command. A mixed oracle such as `test $(git show main:f | wc -l) -ge 1 && test $(wc -l < g) -eq 42` hides the frozen 42 behind the unrelated live token. Again this matches the PRD notes ('when NO live re-derivation token appears in the SAME criterion'), so it is spec-conformant; a per-comparand scoping would be strictly stronger and is worth a follow-up.
